 Sports SEC TV times, channels: South Carolina-Tennessee a most curious matchup
 Gamecocks a home favorite over No. 11 Vols in Columbia. LSU at Auburn an elimination game. Share Tennessee coach Josh Heupel is 2-1 against South Carolina coach Shane Beamer, but the teams have not met since 2023. (Artie Walker Jr./AP) By Mike Griffith Oct 22, 2026 ATHENS — Those who dared to blink last week might have missed a lot, and the same could hold true with another enticing slate of SEC games.
 Although it’s not likely history will be made in the same fashion — five of the top seven-ranked teams in the AP Top 25 poll lost on the same day for the first time in history, including the top three ranked SEC teams — College Football Playoff spots could be on the line.
 For that matter, head coaching jobs might ultimately be on the line, too.
 Related Story How to watch Georgia Tech football vs. Boston College: TV channel, radio info South Carolina coach Shane Beamer finds his team in the curious position of being a betting favorite over No. 11 Tennessee, which is coming off a convincing 26-10 win over then-No. 6 Alabama last Saturday.
